Elon Musk says tunnels are one of the most overlooked solutions for solving traffic.

Musk explained that The Boring Company was created after years of pushing the idea that transportation should move into 3D, just like cities already do with skyscrapers and multi-level buildings.

Instead of endlessly expanding roads on the surface, underground tunnel networks could dramatically reduce congestion and increase transport efficiency.

He also encouraged more companies to enter the tunneling industry, saying there is massive opportunity in underground infrastructure and that The Boring Company should not be the only serious player in the space.

ELON MUSK: A true Kardashev-scale civilization will require infrastructure beyond Earth.

Musk says the future of advanced AI could eventually demand energy at a scale our planet alone may struggle to support. That’s why long-term growth may depend on Moon bases, mass drivers and massive space-based solar power systems.

According to Musk, solar-powered AI satellites launched at enormous scale could generate terawatt-level energy, but doing so would require millions of tons of payload reaching orbit every year.

The long-term vision goes even further. Lunar infrastructure and industrialization could eventually unlock petawatt-scale power generation, making today’s global economy look tiny by comparison.

The limiting factor is no longer physics. It’s how fast humanity can build.

Earth is tiny compared to what exists beyond it.

Human civilization currently uses only a microscopic fraction of the Sun’s energy. Even if humanity increased its energy usage a million times over, it would still be almost nothing compared to the scale and power of the Sun.

The Sun contains roughly 99.8% of the mass in the entire solar system. Everything else, including Earth, is incredibly small in comparison.

Musk believes this is why civilization cannot remain Earth-bound forever. The long-term future of humanity depends on expanding into space where energy, resources and growth potential exist at an almost unimaginable scale.

For a truly advanced civilization, space is not a side project. It’s the next frontier.

Elon Musk says space-based data centers may be far more achievable than most people realize.

Musk pointed to SpaceX already operating around 10,000 satellites in orbit today, with Starship expected to eventually launch more than 10,000 next-generation communication satellites every year.

He says future satellite capability could increase global space-based communications capacity by 100x compared to today.

But according to Musk, even that could be small compared to what comes next: massive AI-focused satellite infrastructure and data centers operating directly in space.

The scale of what Starship could enable is difficult to fully comprehend.
